title: San Francisco to Santa Cruz Day Trip: Redwoods and Beach Fun
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
parents must bring their own rear facing car seat for children under 2 years of age
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Venture from San Francisco to Santa Cruz for a day filled with nature and seaside excitement. First stop at Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park, where you can stroll among towering redwoods. Next stop Santa Cruz, where the boardwalk awaits with its vibrant attractions, tasty food options, and stunning beach. Whether you ride roller coasters, relax on the sand, go out on the water or explore tide pools, this trip offers something for everyone.
